Spaces we’ve designed

Homes and workplaces planned around budget, lifestyle and space, then built and installed by our own team.

Residence 01: Full Apartment Interior

A complete apartment designed room by room: an arched living room with brass detailing, a blush master suite, a playful kids’ room, a marble-look dining area and a U-shaped modular kitchen.

  • Living Room: Arch wall, stone cladding and a fluted-glass partition.
  • Master Bedroom: Floating bed, wood-texture wall and a gloss wardrobe.
  • Guest Bedroom: Back-lit moon feature in a fluted wall.
  • Kids' Room: Scalloped headboard, window seat and study corner.
  • Dining: Marble-look table under a lit glass crockery unit.
  • Modular Kitchen: Shaker shutters and lit glass uppers.
